statement: At D.45's characteristic SL2(F5)^19×C2² refinement, all 324,000,000 finite involution coordinate pairs satisfy the D.44 first-symmetry coboundary condition, while exactly 10,125,000 satisfy D.35's exact conjugator equations. Requiring actual finite invertibility and both Harbater–Schneps relations for the conjugator leaves this count unchanged. Exactly four of the 64 refined f-coordinates pass over each of D.38's 2,531,250 conjugator-compatible base tuples; none passes over the other 2,531,250. The 313,875,000 failures are outside the image of the standard full conjugacy class.
manuscript_passages: Part D of the task: full GT_0 involution conjugacy
notes: The parameter is tracked modulo 120 so that its power residue modulo 60 and m=(a−1)/2 modulo 60 are both exact. The computation distinguishes normalized f-coordinate pairs from finite automorphisms: the 64 f-coordinates over one base tuple induce one actual automorphism. All four first-equation matrices per component, linked theta choices, matrix conjugacy classes, and second-cycle equations are exhausted. No full survivor lift is asserted.
